explication: Dark Reader is a browser extension that analyzes pages and applies a customizable dark theme; it also exposes a JavaScript API for websites. In the extension workflow, users configure behavior through the popup or options UI, while background services manage settings and tabs and communicate with injected content scripts. The content script detects page conditions and applies theme CSS. The API independently enables, disables, follows the system color scheme, and exports generated CSS. Several subsystem links are documented by imports or README behavior; unsampled message routing is not inferred.
